1: “Look, ⌞the hope of capturing it⌟ is false. Will one be hurled down even at its sight?
2: Is it not fierce when somebody stirs it? Who then is he who would stand ⌞before it⌟?
3: Who has come to confront me, that I should repay him? Under all the heavens, ⌞it belongs to me⌟.
4: “I will not keep quiet concerning its limbs or concerning the extent of its might and the gracefulness of its frame.
5: Who can strip off ⌞its outer covering⌟? Who can penetrate its double harness?
6: Who can open the doors of its face? Its teeth all around are fearsome.
7: Its back has scales of shields; it is shut up closely as with a seal.
8: They are close ⌞to one another⌟ — even the air cannot come between them.
9: They are joined ⌞one to another⌟; they cling together and cannot be separated.
10: “Its snorting flashes forth light, and its eyes are ⌞red like dawn⌟.
11: Torches go from its mouth; sparks of fire shoot out.
12: Smoke comes from its nostrils as from a kettle boiling and burning bulrushes.
13: Its breath kindles charcoal, and a flame comes from its mouth.
14: “Strength abides in its neck, and dismay dances ⌞before it⌟.
15: Its flesh’s folds of skin cling together; it is cast on it—it will not be moved.
16: Its heart is cast as stone; yes, it is cast as the lower millstone.
17: ⌞When it raises itself⌟, the mighty ones are terrified; they retreat because of its thrashing.
18: Reaching it with the sword does not avail, nor with the spear, the dart, or the javelin.
19: It regards iron as straw, bronze as rotten wood.
20: ⌞An arrow⌟ will not make it flee; sling stones are turned to stubble for it.
21: Clubs are regarded as stubble, and it laughs at the short sword’s rattle.
22: “Its underparts are shards of a potsherd; it moves over mud like a threshing sledge.
23: It makes the deep boil like a cooking pot; it makes the sea like a pot of ointment.
24: Behind it, ⌞it leaves a glistening wake⌟; one would think that the deep has gray hair.
25: “⌞On the ground it has no equal⌟ — a creature without fear.
26: It observes all the lofty; it is king ⌞over all that are proud⌟.”
